news.title: Trump's tariffs have become America's new normal
news.summary: Even a Democratic administration may struggle to reverse tariffs that help finance Trump's tax cuts.
news.body: Even a Democratic administration may struggle to reverse tariffs that help finance Trump's tax cuts. Markets hardly blinked at the announcement of a new series of proposed tariff schedules from United States President Donald Trump's administration on November 25. Although the affected economies - including the European Union, China, Japan, Indonesia and Taiwan - account for more than 53 percent of US goods trade, the announcement was met with something of a whimper. On November 25, the S&P 500 and the benchmark 10-year Treasury bond hardly moved. Compare that with the turmoil that followed Trump's April 2, 2025, "Liberation Day" announcements. news.body: January WTI crude oil (CLF27) closed down -0.60 (-0.72%) on Friday, and January RBOB gasoline (RBF27) closed up +0.0066 (+0.27%). Crude oil and gasoline prices gave up an early advance on Friday and settled mixed. Dollar strength on Friday weighed on energy prices. news.title: The explosion of extreme wealth is the major problem of our time
news.summary: We see it in America today, where the top 1% now owns more wealth than the bottom 93% and one man, Elon Musk, owns more wealth than the bottom 53% of American households.
news.body: We see it in America today, where the top 1% now owns more wealth than the bottom 93% and one man, Elon Musk, owns more wealth than the bottom 53% of American households. We see it in Russia, where the latest figures indicate that the wealthiest 500 people in that country control more wealth than the bottom 99.8% of their people. We see it in France, where more than one out of five children live in poverty, while 53 billionaires own more wealth than the bottom half of the population. We see it in Africa, where in recent years, nearly 850 million people have struggled with food insecurity, while just four men own more wealth than the bottom 50% of the people on that continent.
